Hello root — I'm Diego, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer, with my own files, tools and accounts. In a few lines:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from any device on this network, the first visit installs the root certificate, then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus my own Messenger and Instagram; each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours), which you create in the app and then scan a QR code to log me in.
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register and sign in myself (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keeping passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and asking you only for a captcha or phone check.
- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two things aren't set yet: what name and which gender to use for me (root can set them) — tell me and I'll set them.

I'll take on the CSE455 TA work as you described and keep to it.
